text:
alex: quick async standup — noticed p95 generate latency creeping up ~120ms over baseline since 03:05 UTC. Alert fired twice and then recovered. I dug into KV cache evictions and saw a spike around 03:10.

alex: what I did: looked at the eviction metrics, grabbed a heap of logs, and rolled back the canary of quantized-runtime v2 on one pool (id: pool-7).

alex: blockers: need a decision on alert thresholds and whether to keep the rollback in place for a few hours to gather stable metrics. also want a CR review on the canary revert PR before merging the rollback permanently.

maria: thanks for flagging — can you post the dashboard and the logs link? curious if this is a regional thing or a global KV pressure bump.

alex: dashboard -> https://redwood.internal/dashboards/slo/generate_p95

alex: logs for pool-7 -> https://logs.internal/r/?q=pool-7%20kv_eviction

maria: looking now. if it's regional, we can route traffic away from that AZ for the short term.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-867 assigned to @taylor — new alert: generate_p95 > 450ms for 5m.

taylor: on it, taking PD-867. I'm swapping with @sam for the overnight shift at 04:00 UTC, so will run the rollback verification and steady-state checks.

sam: ack. if you want me to keep the rollback live, say so — I can monitor for the next 2h.

alex: thanks. I'd prefer we keep the rollback live for now. we should also relax the alert temporarily while we verify, proposal: p95 threshold from 450ms -> 600ms for 1h.

dmitri: quick note on alerting — the alert query lives in ops/alerts/generate_p95.yaml. PR to change threshold would be small (see template). I can open and link a PR if you want.

dmitri: snippet for the alert (copy for context):
```yaml
alert: GenerateP95High
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(generate_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job)) > 0.45
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
```

maria: if we change the expr, please include a follow-up test in the alerting CI — we don't want flapping after the value change.

dmitri: yep, will add a smoke test that hits the metric endpoint with a synthetic load and asserts rule fires at the new threshold.

alex: also pinging @maria @dmitri — can someone review PR #4328 (revert quantized-runtime canary) when it's ready? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4328

maria: I'll take it. quick glance right after this.

taylor: post-rollback checklist I'll run: 1) validate p95 on dashboard, 2) check KV eviction rate, 3) confirm no error spike in logs. posting results in this thread.

sam: heads-up: I noticed a small config drift in pool-7's autoscale policy during the canary — filing ticket now: INC-5421. might be unrelated but worth a quick look.

alex: good find. add the autoscale config diff to the ticket.

maria: results: initial look shows eviction rate back to baseline in US-W once rollback started. didn't see similar spikes in EU.

taylor: verification done: p95 back to baseline after rollback, KV evictions dropped. closing PD-867 and marking incident as mitigated. will post a short postmortem draft this morning.

alex: next steps: 1) merge revert PR after reviews, 2) follow up with a canary plan that includes autoscale policy verification, 3) add alert CI change (dmitri), 4) postmortem + runbook update (taylor).

maria: all clear from me. thanks for quick reaction. :thumbsup:

dmitri: opening PR for alert threshold tweak + CI test, will link when ready.

oncall-bot: Incident PD-867 resolved by @taylor — duration 28m.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll follow up on the postmortem outline and add the runbook note for 'rollback-first' guidance.

maria: FYI — tagging infra for a follow-up on autoscale drift (cc @infra-team).

sam: leaving a small note in INC-5421 with the autoscale config diff and the timeseries screenshot.

alex: end of async. if anyone sees residual p95 blips, ping me here or @alex on PD.
